title: 9 Things a Godly Man Kills Before They Kill Him
caption:
Scripture doesn't say manage your sin. It says put it to death. Most of what's actually killing a man doesn't look like sin at first. It looks like "processing," or "boundaries," or just being realistic.

The self-pity that renames itself processing. The resentment you're calling boundaries. The grudge you're praying about instead of ending. The victim story that gets you out of trying. The contempt you feel for the man you used to be, when God already forgave him.

The comparison that never once made you better. The "I'll deal with it eventually" voice. The anger you keep feeding instead of naming; don't let the sun set on that fire (Ephesians 4:26). The version of you that only shows up for an audience, when God was watching before anyone else was.

Save this and pick the one you've been managing instead of killing.

#faith #putitodeath #godlyman #christianmen #killthesin
